Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface ParameterBindingOperations

public interface ParameterBindingOperations
Editor-authoring operations for typed bindings of one parameter.

Obtain these operations from CubismModel.parameterBindings(dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.id.ParameterId). Inputs identify targets and points using Turboism values only. They are generation-bound and require a provider that can perform the corresponding Editor transaction; unsupported versions fail explicitly.
